# Varanda
Varanda_gallery_studio
<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=utf8><meta name=viewport content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><style>:root{color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}body{margin:0;padding:0;font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;background:#fff;color:#000}img{max-width:100%}[hidden]:not([hidden=until-found i]){display:none!important}</style></head><body>
<title>دعوة ڤرنده</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Amiri:wght@400;700&family=Aref+Ruqaa:wght@400;700&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,600;1,500;1,600&display=block">
<style>
/* Layout: three stacked scenes in a phone-width column. Envelope overlay opens in four panels, then a card scene and a location scene scroll-snap. */
:root{
  --ground:#1f1b18;
  --olive:#7b7d5f;
  --cream:#f3eadb;
  --ink:#5a3a35;
  --rose:#8a5247;
  --gold:#a47e4b;
  --pin:#c9788a;
  --f-title:"Amiri","Geeza Pro","Noto Naskh Arabic","Droid Naskh Shift","Traditional Arabic",serif;
  --f-tag:"Aref Ruqaa","Amiri","Geeza Pro","Noto Naskh Arabic","Droid Naskh Shift",serif;
  --f-body:"Amiri","Geeza Pro","Noto Naskh Arabic","Droid Naskh Shift","Traditional Arabic",serif;
  --f-en:"Cormorant Garamond","Times New Roman",serif;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.72,0,.18,1);
}
:root{--img-env:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");--img-f1:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");--img-f2:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,")}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0;background:var(--ground);color:var(--ink);overflow:hidden}
#app{position:fixed;top:0;bottom:0;left:50%;width:min(100vw,480px);transform:translateX(-50%);overflow:hidden;background:#d9c7b8}
#scroller{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;scroll-snap-type:y mandatory;overscroll-behavior:contain;scrollbar-width:none}
#scroller::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
#scroller.locked{overflow:hidden}
.scene{position:relative;height:100%;scroll-snap-align:start;scroll-snap-stop:always;overflow:hidden;background:#e8d9cc}
.plate{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);container-type:inline-size;background-size:100% 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat}
.p1{width:max(100%,calc(100dvh*.5627));aspect-ratio:736/1308;background-image:var(--img-f1)}
.p2{width:max(100%,calc(100dvh*.5625));aspect-ratio:675/1200;background-image:var(--img-f2)}

/* scene 1: invitation text */
.copy{position:absolute;left:14.5%;width:67%;top:29.5%;bottom:13%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;text-align:center;direction:rtl}
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2.6cqw;font-family:var(--f-tag);font-size:3.5cqw;color:var(--gold);margin:0}
.eyebrow i{display:block;width:8cqw;height:1px;background:currentColor;opacity:.7}
h1{font-family:var(--f-title);font-weight:700;font-size:14cqw;line-height:1.15;margin:0;color:var(--rose);text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,252,246,.8)}
.sw{font-size:.58em;vertical-align:.12em;text-shadow:none;margin-inline-start:.1em}
.tag{font-family:var(--f-tag);font-weight:700;font-size:4.3cqw;line-height:1.7;margin:2cqw 0 0;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--rose)}
.rule{display:block;width:26cqw;height:3cqw;margin:2.8cqw 0 3cqw;color:var(--gold)}
.txt{font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:4.3cqw;line-height:1.75;margin:0 0 2.8cqw;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--ink)}
.txt.last{font-weight:700;font-size:4.3cqw;color:var(--rose);margin:.6cqw 0 0}
.hint{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:2.6%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.4cqw;font-family:var(--f-tag);font-size:3.3cqw;color:#fff8ee;text-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(70,40,40,.55);text-decoration:none}
.hint svg{width:5cqw;height:5cqw;animation:nudge 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes nudge{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(1.4cqw)}}

/* scene 2: location */
.loc{position:absolute;left:16%;width:68%;top:29.5%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;direction:rtl}
.loc h2{font-family:var(--f-title);font-weight:700;font-size:6.4cqw;margin:0 0 2.4cqw;color:var(--rose);line-height:1.2}
.mapcard{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:330/196;border-radius:1.2cqw;padding:1.1cqw;background:#fbf3e6;box-shadow:0 0 0 .35cqw var(--gold),0 2.4cqw 5cqw -1.5cqw rgba(90,58,53,.45);box-sizing:border-box}
.mapcard svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:.6cqw}
.go{margin-top:3.4cqw;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2cqw;width:74%;padding:2.3cqw 3cqw;border-radius:99cqw;background:var(--rose);color:#fff7ee;text-decoration:none;font-family:var(--f-en);font-style:italic;font-weight:600;font-size:5cqw;letter-spacing:.02em;box-shadow:0 1.6cqw 3.6cqw -1.2cqw rgba(90,50,45,.6);direction:ltr}
.go svg{width:4.6cqw;height:4.6cqw;flex:none}
.go:focus-visible,.mapcard:focus-visible,.seal:focus-visible,.hint:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px}

.info{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);width:116%;margin:0 0 3cqw;padding-bottom:3cqw;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(164,126,75,.45)}
.it{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.8cqw;color:var(--rose);text-decoration:none;font-family:var(--f-body)}
.it svg{width:7cqw;height:7cqw;color:var(--gold)}
.it b{font-family:var(--f-en);font-weight:600;font-size:5.4cqw;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:.03em;font-variant-numeric:lining-nums}
a.it b{font-family:var(--f-title);font-size:5.2cqw}
.it small{font-family:var(--f-tag);font-size:3cqw;color:var(--gold)}
.loc h2{margin-top:0}
.go{border:0;cursor:pointer;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.addr{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .7s var(--ease),margin .7s var(--ease);margin-top:0}
.addr-in{overflow:hidden;min-height:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2.4cqw;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-1.2cqw);transition:opacity .7s ease .15s,transform .7s ease .15s;text-align:center;color:var(--rose)}
.addr.on .addr-in{padding:2.4cqw 3cqw;background:#fbf3e6;border-radius:1.6cqw;box-shadow:0 0 0 .35cqw var(--gold),0 2cqw 4cqw -1.5cqw rgba(90,58,53,.45)}
.addr-in svg{display:none}
.addr-in p{margin:0;font-family:var(--f-title);font-weight:700;font-size:3.7cqw;line-height:1.7;white-space:nowrap}
.addr-in small{display:block;font-family:var(--f-tag);font-weight:400;font-size:3cqw;color:var(--gold);line-height:1.4}
.addr.on{grid-template-rows:1fr;margin-top:3.4cqw}
.addr.on .addr-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.addr,.addr-in{transition-duration:.01s!important}}
/* entrance */
.js .rise{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);transition:opacity .9s ease,transform .9s ease}
.js .rise.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.js .rise.d1{transition-delay:.12s}.js .rise.d2{transition-delay:.24s}.js .rise.d3{transition-delay:.36s}
.revealed .copy>*{animation:up 1s both}
.revealed .copy>*:nth-child(1){animation-delay:1.5s}.revealed .copy>*:nth-child(2){animation-delay:1.7s}.revealed .copy>*:nth-child(3){animation-delay:1.9s}.revealed .copy>*:nth-child(4){animation-delay:2.1s}.revealed .copy>*:nth-child(5){animation-delay:2.3s}.revealed .copy>*:nth-child(6){animation-delay:2.5s}
@keyframes up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.p1{transition:transform 2.6s cubic-bezier(.3,.1,.2,1)}
.pre .p1{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.08)}

/* envelope overlay */
#env{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:20;overflow:hidden;background:var(--olive)}
.sheet{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:max(100%,calc(100dvh*.6103));aspect-ratio:736/1206;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);container-type:inline-size}
.pc{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--img-env) center/100% 100% no-repeat;transition:transform 1.5s var(--ease),opacity 1.5s ease}
.sheet{perspective:1800px}
.pc{backface-visibility:hidden;will-change:transform}
.pc.l{clip-path:polygon(0 0,50% 0,50% 100%,0 100%);transform-origin:0 50%}
.pc.r{clip-path:polygon(50% 0,100% 0,100% 100%,50% 100%);transform-origin:100% 50%}
.pc::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(25,28,15,0),rgba(25,28,15,.55));opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.6s ease}
.pc.r::after{background:linear-gradient(270deg,rgba(25,28,15,0),rgba(25,28,15,.55))}
.seal{position:absolute;left:49.6%;top:46.4%;width:40%;aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;border:0;background:transparent;padding:0;cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;z-index:3}
.ring{position:absolute;left:49.6%;top:46.4%;width:38%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,250,240,.75);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);animation:ring 2.4s ease-out infinite;pointer-events:none;z-index:2}
.ring.two{animation-delay:1.2s}
@keyframes ring{0%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.95);opacity:.8}100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.45);opacity:0}}
.tap{position:absolute;left:49.6%;top:62%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-family:var(--f-en);font-style:italic;font-weight:500;font-size:6.2cqw;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#f6efe0;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(40,45,25,.55);pointer-events:none;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2.4cqw;white-space:nowrap}
.tap i{display:block;width:7cqw;height:1px;background:currentColor;opacity:.7}
#env.opening .pc{transition:transform 2.1s cubic-bezier(.6,.02,.2,1) .25s,opacity .7s ease 1.9s}
#env.opening .pc.l{transform:rotateY(-98deg) translateX(-4%);opacity:0}
#env.opening .pc.r{transform:rotateY(98deg) translateX(4%);opacity:0}
#env.opening .pc::after{opacity:1}
#env.opening .seal,#env.opening .ring,#env.opening .tap{opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s ease;animation:none}
#env.opening{background:transparent;transition:background .2s .1s}
#env.pressed .sheet{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.985);transition:transform .18s ease}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .pc,.p1,.js .rise{transition-duration:.01s!important;transition-delay:0s!important}
  .ring,.hint svg,.revealed .copy>*{animation:none!important}
  .pre .p1{transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
}
</style>
<div id="app" class="pre">
  <main id="scroller" class="locked">
    <section class="scene" id="s1" aria-label="الدعوة">
      <div class="plate p1">
        <div class="copy">
          <h1>ڤرنده <span class="sw" aria-hidden="true">🦢</span></h1>
          <p class="tag">بعض الأماكن لا تُزار فقط، بل تُشبه<br>الحكايات التي نحب أن نعيشها…</p>
          <svg class="rule" viewBox="0 0 120 12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 6h46M72 6h46"/><path d="M60 1.500l4.500 4.500L60 10.500 55.500 6z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>
          <p class="txt">من قلب ڤرنده، يسعدنا دعوتكم<br>لاكتشاف عالم من التفاصيل،<br>والذكريات، والجمال الذي<br>يسكن أبسط الأشياء.</p>
          <p class="txt last">ننتظركم لنشارككم بداية<br>حكاية جديدة، ونكون سعداء<br>بوجودكم بيننا.</p>
        </div>
        <a class="hint" href="#s2" id="toLoc" aria-label="الانتقال إلى الموقع"><span>الموقع</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 9l7 7 7-7"/></svg></a>
      </div>
    </section>
    <section class="scene" id="s2" aria-label="الموقع">
      <div class="plate p2">
        <div class="loc">
          <div class="info rise" dir="rtl">
            <div class="it"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="4" y="5.500" width="16" height="15" rx="2"/><path d="M4 10h16M8.500 3.500v4M15.500 3.500v4"/></svg><b dir="ltr">11/11</b><small>التاريخ</small></div>
            <div class="it"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 21s-7-6.200-7-11.500A7 7 0 0 1 19 9.500C19 14.800 12 21 12 21z"/><circle cx="12" cy="9.500" r="2.500"/></svg><b>اللوكيشن</b><small>ڤرنده</small></div>
            <div class="it"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12.500" r="8"/><path d="M12 8v4.500l3 2M5 4.500L3 6.500M19 4.500l2 2"/></svg><b dir="ltr">9 PM</b><small>الموعد</small></div>
          </div>
          <h2 class="rise d1">موقعنا</h2>
          <div class="mapcard rise d1" role="img" aria-label="خريطة موقع ڤرنده"><svg viewBox="0 0 330 196" role="img" aria-label="خريطة موقع ڤرنده" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="vg" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="75%"><stop offset="60%" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b99a78" stop-opacity=".35"/></radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="wt" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#cfd9d4"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#d9e0da"/></linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="330" height="196" fill="#ecdfcb"/>
  <g fill="#f6ecdd">
    <rect x="8" y="10" width="62" height="44" rx="3"/><rect x="84" y="10" width="70" height="44" rx="3"/>
    <rect x="8" y="70" width="62" height="50" rx="3"/><rect x="84" y="70" width="70" height="50" rx="3"/>
    <rect x="186" y="10" width="62" height="44" rx="3"/><rect x="262" y="10" width="60" height="44" rx="3"/>
    <rect x="262" y="70" width="60" height="50" rx="3"/><rect x="8" y="136" width="62" height="52" rx="3"/>
    <rect x="186" y="136" width="62" height="52" rx="3"/><rect x="262" y="136" width="60" height="52" rx="3"/>
  </g>
  <path d="M168 66h76v54h-76z" fill="#c8d1b3"/>
  <g fill="#b3bf9a"><circle cx="186" cy="82" r="7"/><circle cx="206" cy="100" r="9"/><circle cx="228" cy="84" r="6"/><circle cx="222" cy="108" r="5"/></g>
  <path d="M84 136c28-6 52 4 70 0v52H84z" fill="url(#wt)" opacity=".0"/>
  <g stroke="#fffaf0" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
    <path d="M0 62H330" stroke-width="9"/><path d="M0 128H330" stroke-width="7"/>
    <path d="M77 0V196" stroke-width="8"/><path d="M168 0V196" stroke-width="10"/><path d="M255 0V196" stroke-width="7"/>
    <path d="M0 178C70 160 120 190 200 170S300 150 330 160" stroke-width="5" opacity=".9"/>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#e3d2b9" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity=".9"><path d="M0 62H330M0 128H330M77 0V196M168 0V196M255 0V196"/></g>
  <path d="M168 128C168 100 168 90 168 74" stroke="#c9788a" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="1 5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0"/>
  <g transform="translate(168 100)">
    <circle r="22" fill="#c9788a" opacity=".16"/><circle r="12" fill="#c9788a" opacity=".22"/>
    <path d="M0-30c-10 0-17 7.4-17 16.4C-17-1 0 12 0 12s17-13 17-25.6C17-22.600 10-30 0-30z" fill="#c9788a" stroke="#fff7ee" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cy="-13.500" r="6" fill="#fff7ee"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(168 140)"><rect x="-30" y="-10" width="60" height="20" rx="10" fill="#fbf3e6" stroke="#a47e4b" stroke-width="1"/><text y="5" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Amiri,serif" font-weight="700" font-size="14" fill="#8a5247">ڤرنده</text></g>
  <rect width="330" height="196" fill="url(#vg)"/>
</svg></div>
          <button class="go rise d2" id="go" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="addr"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 21s-7-6.200-7-11.500A7 7 0 0 1 19 9.500C19 14.800 12 21 12 21z"/><circle cx="12" cy="9.500" r="2.500"/></svg><span>See location</span></button>
          <div class="addr" id="addr" role="status" aria-live="polite">
            <div class="addr-in"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 21s-7-6.200-7-11.500A7 7 0 0 1 19 9.500C19 14.800 12 21 12 21z"/><circle cx="12" cy="9.500" r="2.500"/></svg><p><small>العنوان</small>برج الفرسان، بجوار كافيه دار سليم<br>مركز إصدار طنطا</p></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>
  <div id="env" role="dialog" aria-label="ظرف الدعوة">
    <div class="sheet">
      <div class="pc l"></div><div class="pc r"></div>
      <span class="ring"></span><span class="ring two"></span>
      <button class="seal" id="seal" type="button" aria-label="افتح الدعوة"></button>
      <div class="tap"><i></i>tap here<i></i></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  var root=document.documentElement; root.classList.add('js');
  var app=document.getElementById('app'),env=document.getElementById('env'),sc=document.getElementById('scroller'),s1=document.getElementById('s1');
  var opened=false;
  function open(){
    if(opened) return; opened=true;
    env.classList.add('pressed');
    setTimeout(function(){
      env.classList.remove('pressed'); env.classList.add('opening');
      app.classList.remove('pre'); s1.classList.add('revealed');
      setTimeout(function(){ env.hidden=true; sc.classList.remove('locked'); },2800);
    },170);
  }
  document.getElementById('seal').addEventListener('click',open);
  var io=null;
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
    io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){ if(e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('in'); });},{root:sc,threshold:.2});
    document.querySelectorAll('.rise').forEach(function(el){io.observe(el);});
  } else { document.querySelectorAll('.rise').forEach(function(el){el.classList.add('in');}); }
  document.getElementById('toLoc').addEventListener('click',function(ev){ev.preventDefault();document.getElementById('s2').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});});

  var go=document.getElementById('go'),addr=document.getElementById('addr');
  go.addEventListener('click',function(){var on=addr.classList.toggle('on');go.setAttribute('aria-expanded',on?'true':'false');});
})();
</script>

</body></html>
